note: Capture for the DARPA Crusher UGCV, the vehicle the Armed Assault Wiki names for the ARMA 3 UGV Stomper and UGV Saif. The UGV Saif page is a redirect to UGV Stomper, so one capture serves both. The page states the basis and publishes no mass, dimension, engine or tyre figure, so the entry is identity only and every runtime field resolves to a labelled absent zero.
